text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre was set to take part in a joint 
live performance. However...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... The customers seem to be getting 
frustrated...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It is well past the scheduled start time, 
after all...

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
To all the performers, we are so very 
sorry! It looks like repairing the 
equipment is going to take some time...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!? We can't start yet!?

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... Um, we'll explain things to the 
guests, so everyone please stand by!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
We sincerely apologize for the 
inconvenience...! We are currently working 
on repairing the equipment! We will 
contact you as soon as there is any 
progress!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The staff desperately went around 
explaining the situation to the waiting 
spectators. But...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
—Ehhhh!? What's that about~~!? —I've been 
waiting forever, you know!? —Hurry up and 
get started already~~!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What is up with that...? She won't listen 
to a single word.
choice_data_list: What do I do? At this rate...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: What a nuisance.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Stand down. You are in the presence of the 
King.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
—!? The "Tyrant"... Orfevre...! 
—...*Gulp*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre stands proudly upon the stage. 
Bathed in the lights, her divine presence 
leaves everyone breathless."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The celebration will surely be held. There 
is no error in my decree.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Therefore, just wait in silence.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Such is the King's decree.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: —Y-Yes...! —Right... away...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Overwhelmed by Orfevre's aura, the entire 
audience fell dead silent. After 
witnessing this, she retreated to the 
backstage wings.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I'll sleep until the equipment is 
restored. Let me know when it's done.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... What's that about? You're not half 
bad...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
In any case, thanks to her, the panic has 
subsided. We have to maintain this 
state...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Right! Let's do everything we can so that 
another commotion doesn't happen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A short while after that. With the 
equipment restored and an estimated start 
time for the live performance set, I went 
to inform Orfevre.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —...I see. And where is the venue?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since then, the other Umamusume had been 
doing their best to prevent a panic. 
Durandal helped with security at the 
venue—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho handed out magic water (tea) 
to prevent dehydration, while Curren Chan 
kept the audience engaged to buy time.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Hm. Well then, perhaps I shall reward 
someone for their hard work.
choice_data_list:
I want you to reassure the audience with 
your own words.

I want you to reassure the audience with 
your own words.
Go thank Durandal for securing the venue

Let's praise Sweep Tosho for healing with 
magic.

Words of praise for Curren Chan, who 
charmed everyone with her endearing appeal

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Hm. Well then, perhaps I shall reward 
someone for their hard work.
choice_data_list:
I want you to reassure the audience with 
your own words.

I want you to reassure the audience with 
your own words.
Go thank Durandal for securing the venue

Let's praise Sweep Tosho for healing with 
magic.

Words of praise for Curren Chan, who 
charmed everyone with her endearing appeal

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Consider this a reward for the 
subjects who waited so patiently.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Rejoice. The festival will soon begin.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Behold. The golden stage that overwhelms 
all!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The audience cheered at Orfevre's words. 
Afterward, the live concert concluded 
without incident—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hoh. So word of what happened at the 
recent concert has spread to the public, 
has it?
choice_data_list:
People are talking all about you on social 
media!

People are talking all about you on social 
media!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having quelled the panic with her 
overwhelming aura, Orfevre captured the 
public's undivided attention.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—Lend your ears. The festival shall open 
shortly.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"This is your reward for waiting so 
quietly. Enjoy it to your heart's 
content."

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
—To be praised by someone of such high 
standing...! —Maybe waiting quietly was 
worth it after all...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The audience was completely captivated by 
Orfevre. Afterwards, the equipment was 
restored, and the concert concluded as a 
massive success.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: In that case, lead the way.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
You over there, fighting is strictly 
prohibited. If you cannot comply, you will 
be escorted from the venue, so keep that 
in mind.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
So it was you who maintained order. I 
commend your service.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Huh, Orfevre-san...?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I'm being praised right now...! If that's 
the case—"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Sir! I am truly honored and grateful for 
your kind words of praise!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Durandal accepted Orfevre's praise like a 
true knight. Afterward, the live concert 
successfully began.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hoh. Very well.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oregano Recovery! Here, drink this and 
cheer up!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Quenching the thirst of the people, were 
you? Good work."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! What's your deal?! Popping out of 
nowhere talking about 'doing a good job'~?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course! I am a great mage, after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho puffed out her chest with 
pride at Orfevre's praise. Afterward, the 
live concert successfully began.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I see. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Let's practice the call-and-response for 
the big show~~! Ready, and...?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Cute Curren Chaaan!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. To think you've won the hearts of 
the people to this extent.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Orfe-san, wanna practice too? Call and 
response!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Heeere I go~~! Ready, and?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I shall not.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre seemed impressed by Curren Chan's 
ability to captivate the audience despite 
her words. Afterward, the concert kicked 
off without a hitch.
